propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan in or execute activated project-owned LLM criteria in Pass 1 discovery phase.
Pass 3 repository-effective routing does not consistently apply project-criterion thresholds, posture, and nit-suppression values from the active routing view.
Project criterion eval resolution is plan-review-biased and the code-review solver gate accepts only a closed set of prompts rather than routing-declared ones.

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion must maintain architectural separation: Pass 1 discovers only, Pass 2 assesses validity/impact, Pass 3 applies deterministic thresholds, and Pass 4 coaches without re-adjudication.

Generic code-review project-criterion integration must preserve backward compatibility for repositories without overlays and map logical project.<name> ids to validator-safe physical code-review-project-<name> ids.
